notes: USABLE WITH CAVEATS — conditional. De et al. 2025 randomized open-label comparison, 20 mg oral capsules nightly after meals for 12 weeks, 30 monotherapy participants, all completed. Small sample, short course, unknown capsule brand; comparator adds topical minocycline and its IL baseline differs between source Tables 1 and 2. Only the monotherapy inflammatory-lesion count series is used. This is not ABSORICA, weight-based dosing, or a nodular-only endpoint. Visit count SDs are not change SDs. No graded skin-side-effect trajectory is available, so simulated side-effect burden will be underestimated.
